items.title: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list
items.excerpt: The Alexa for Shopping AI assistant can now order groceries and recommend products over text messages, launching by invite in the US ahead of the holidays.

items.title: Google's eyewear partners can't keep a lid on its smart glasses plans
items.excerpt: Gentle Monster says its Gemini-powered Android XR 'Intelligent Eyewear' opens for pre-order November 12, teased with a Jonathan Glazer short film starring Joaquin Phoenix; the display-free, audio-first glasses offer Gemini access. (Glasses slot; follow-up to 11-06 Samsung XR glasses coverage.)

items.title: 엔비디아, 'RTX 스파크' 기술 소개…차세대 'AI PC' 경험 제시
items.excerpt: 엔비디아가 서울 기자간담회에서 GPU·CPU 단일 슈퍼칩 'RTX 스파크(N1X)'로 클라우드 없이 PC에서 AI 에이전트를 구동하는 로컬 AI 전략과 경량 모델, 로컬·클라우드 하이브리드 기술을 공개했다. 최대 128GB 통합 메모리, 1페타플롭 AI 성능.

items.title: Latest Google app reveals Gemini Live's offline mode requires an online setup
items.excerpt: Google app v17.73.15 strings show Gemini Live's upcoming offline mode must be set up while connected and will run 'with limited features' on-device. APK teardown; follow-up to an earlier offline-mode teardown.

items.title: Apple just added Suggested Actions to iOS 27.2 — the Apple Intelligence upgrade scans your texts to create one-tap buttons
items.excerpt: iOS 27.2 adds Apple Intelligence-powered Suggested Actions in Messages that turn texts into one-tap shortcuts for Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Maps.

items.title: Motorola's new earbuds are gunning for AirPods with Bose sound and some handy AI features
items.excerpt: Motorola's Moto Buds Ultra 27 (Moto Buds 2 Ultra) pair Bose-tuned audio with live AI translation and gesture controls to take on AirPods Pro and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro.

items.title: HomeView will support third-party AI chatbots, suggests code
items.excerpt: Code in the iOS 27.3 beta suggests Apple's HomeView smart home hub will gain support for third-party AI chatbots alongside Siri.

items.title: Sonos AI coming in controlled beta as company aims to avoid another app disaster
items.excerpt: Sonos is rolling out its AI voice assistant and app features through a controlled beta and explains how speaker owners can get access. (Follow-up to previously published Sonos voice early-access news.)

items.title: Open source project renders your Windows 11 desktop using the NPU rather than the GPU
items.excerpt: A research 'npu-driver' renders the Windows 11 desktop on an Intel Panther Lake NPU instead of the GPU; it currently manages only 2-3 Hz and targets 30 Hz.

items.title: My local LLM turns my voice notes into to-do items automatically, and nothing falls through the cracks
items.excerpt: A hands-on workflow using a locally run LLM to transcribe voice notes and turn them into to-do items without sending data to the cloud.

items.title: I replaced Grammarly Pro with a local model on my GPU, and my drafts never leave my PC
items.excerpt: XDA swaps a Grammarly subscription for a local Qwen model running on a consumer GPU, keeping writing private on-device.

items.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.excerpt: Tau Robotics is sending humanoid robots to clean San Francisco homes; they still need lots of remote human guidance but are learning. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered Tau this week.)

items.title: Tau Robotics opens robot cleaner subscriptions at $60 a visit as the hourly rate climbs to $50
items.excerpt: Tau's humanoid cleaning service leaves pilot: $50 per humanoid per hour, weekly subscriptions at $60 a visit, Los Angeles expansion, and recorded-home footage used for training. (Off-list; same story as MIT TR item.)

items.title: Syncere Lume robot lamp folds laundry and makes the bed for $2,699
items.excerpt: Syncere's Lume is a $2,699 floor lamp hiding a robot arm with onboard perception and local AI compute that folds laundry, makes the bed and tidies; lifetime autonomy costs $679, invite-only deliveries in H1 2027. (Off-list.)

items.title: Pudu TOMO S robot mower sharpens its own blades at the dock
items.excerpt: Pudu's TOMO S robot mower combines 360-degree LiDAR with binocular AI vision and an AI Mowing Planner, and sharpens its own blades at the dock; on sale early 2027. (Off-list; AI is secondary to the blade-sharpening hook.)

items.title: Can a Radar-Equipped AC Actually Cut Your Power Bill?
items.excerpt: AI-powered air conditioners from LG, Samsung and Dyson now use radar to track occupants room to room; WIRED tests whether 'AI Direct/Indirect Wind' and AI energy modes actually save power.

items.title: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
items.excerpt: inMusic is opening up MPCs and hackable synths as AI vibe-coded firmware mods upend the music gear world; Akai and Moog embrace them while Elektron is wary.
